name: vigor of the hill giant
desc: You’ve manifested the resilient power of hill giants, granting you the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- Bulwark: When you are subjected to an effect that would move you, knock you prone, or both, you can use your reaction to not be moved or knocked prone.

- Hearty Recovery: Whenever you regain hit points from a spell or a magic item, you regain an additional 1d8 hit points. You can regain these extra hit points a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
